title: Open-Meteo historical archive — Réunion grid point, 8–19 October 2026
claims: The archive returned the nearest grid point at 21.195° S, 55.483° E, elevation 1,166 m, timezone Indian/Reunion (UTC+4).
For the 12-day window 8–19 October 2026 the modelled daily maximum ranged from 18.7 °C to 22.6 °C with a median of 20.8 °C.
The modelled daily minimum ranged from 9.8 °C to 12.3 °C with a median of 11.3 °C.
8 of the 12 days had at least 1 mm of precipitation and 4 had at least 5 mm, with a window total of 39.2 mm.
On 15 October 2026 the modelled maximum was 20.5 °C, the minimum 9.8 °C and precipitation 0.4 mm.
These values are modelled grid-point data, not measurements taken on the race course.
